name: Scepter of the Council
label: Quest
description: Scepter of the Council: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Huum and I were just talking about you. He tells me you're just about ready to try your hand at fighting an Abyssal Lord!

I must tell you this is a very dangerous endeavor. You'd better bring backup. And I don't mean one or two of your friends, I'm talking about a top-notch, battle-ready fighting force. If your friends are as good as you, you might even defeat it!
If you do - and I'll want evidence, as always - I'll give you a truly great reward.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Well, how did it go? I'd do anything to leave my post and wrestle one of those things myself!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You... You did it! You did it, friend! Here! Take this. It's the biggest chest we had lying around and I filled it with some of the best stuff we found.
